newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Polifarbs choose firm to advise on merger.
newsitem.headline: Polish Polifarbs choose firm to advise on merger.

text.p: Polish paintmakers Polifarb Wroclaw SA and Polifarb Cieszyn SA, which seek to merge at mid-year, chose BIG Finance Sp z o o to advise on the move, the firms said in separate statements.
Polifarb Cieszyn's finance director Wieslaw Labrenc on Tuesday confirmed his company's participation in the deal but would not give any details.
Late last week Poland's anti-monopoly office said it had no objection to the planned merger.
Under the plan Cieszyn would raise its share capital by 2,978,820 shares to equal Wroclaw's 22,103,820 shares.
Later Cieszyn would set another issue for Wroclaw shareholders and a one-for-one share exchange would take place to effect the merger.
The new entity, which is expected to have about 40 percent of the market, would be able to produce at both Wroclaw and Cieszyn with the city of Wroclaw chosen as the headquarters of the new firm.
